#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const ll MOD = 998244353;

ll powerMod(ll b, ll e, ll m) {
    if (e == 0) return 1;
    ll half = powerMod(b, e / 2, m);
    half = (half * half) % m;
    if (e % 2 == 1) half = (half * b) % m;
    return half;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll n, m;
    int L, R;
    cin >> n >> m >> L >> R;

    ll diff = R - L + 1;
    ll p1 = diff / 2;
    ll p2 = diff - p1;
    ll nm = n * m;
    ll ans;
    ll inv2 = powerMod(2, MOD - 2, MOD);

    if (nm % 2 == 1) {
        ans = powerMod(diff, nm, MOD);
    } else {
        ll pp1 = diff;
        ll pp2 = abs(p1 - p2);
        ll opt1 = powerMod(pp1, nm, MOD);
        ll opt2 = powerMod(pp2, nm, MOD);
        ll opt = (opt1 + opt2) % MOD;
        opt = (opt * inv2) % MOD;
        ans = opt;
    }

    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
